description: This file defines the Config_File class for reading and parsing configuration files in PHP, including methods for loading files, retrieving configuration data, and handling parsing logic.

classes.name: Config_File
classes.description: A class for managing configuration files, including loading, parsing, and retrieving configuration data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that optionally sets the configuration path.

methods.name: set_path
methods.description: Sets the directory path where configuration files are located.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves configuration data based on filename, section, and variable name.

methods.name: get_key
methods.description: Retrieves configuration data based on a composite key.

methods.name: get_file_names
methods.description: Returns a list of loaded configuration filenames.

methods.name: get_section_names
methods.description: Returns section names from a loaded configuration file.

methods.name: get_var_names
methods.description: Returns variable names from a file or section.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears loaded configuration data for a specific file or all files.

methods.name: load_file
methods.description: Loads and parses a configuration file.

methods.name: set_file_contents
methods.description: Sets configuration data directly from a string.

methods.name: parse_contents
methods.description: Parses configuration data from a string.

methods.name: _set_config_var
methods.description: Sets a configuration variable in a container, handling boolean conversion and overwriting.
